description: A pale pink and green flower-like form with a dark red center and rippling petals sits in the middle of the composition. Black, brown, red, blue, and yellow lines circle the flower form.
imageCaption: Image has not been color proofed to current standards, and its colors may differ from the original work. The Museum will replace it when new photography becomes available.
